pairs.ask: First Buyer: Small Contractors (2-10), Solopreneurs, Or Property Managers Later?

optionA.label: Small Contractors First
optionA.desc: They already pay $29-$599/mo for Jobber; Max has network credibility.

optionB.label: Solopreneurs First
optionB.desc: Broader pool; more like Sintra buyers; less trade-specific proof.

pairs.ask: Package Shape: Done-For-You Setup Plus Monthly, Or Product You Barely Touch?

optionA.label: Done-For-You For Three Pilots
optionA.desc: Sets up 3 lanes in their brand; every client teaches the product.

optionB.label: Hands-Off Product First
optionB.desc: Slower to first revenue; needs multi-tenant before money.

pairs.ask: Founding Pilot Price (Estimate): $750 Setup + $250/mo, Or Lower To Clear Objections?

optionA.label: Keep $750 + $250/mo
optionA.desc: Sits between DIY ($20-$100) and ATI Lab ($2,000 + $500/mo).

optionB.label: Lower For First Three
optionB.desc: Faster yes; harder to raise later.

pairs.ask: Team Tier Next: $2,000 Setup + $500/mo For Up To 8 Lanes, Or Skip Until Pilots Prove It?

optionA.label: Publish Team Tier On The Page
optionA.desc: Shows the ladder; HighLevel analog $97-$497/mo.

optionB.label: Hide Until Pilots Work
optionB.desc: Avoid selling a tier you cannot staff yet.

pairs.ask: Self-Serve Tier At $49-$99/mo: Build After Pilots, Or Sketch Now?

optionA.label: After Pilots Only
optionA.desc: Plan: Self-Serve only after the app exists.

optionB.label: Sketch The Tier Now
optionB.desc: Helps landing-page story; no build commitment.

pairs.ask: Pricing Style: Flat Monthly With No Credits, Or Credit Packs Like Competitors?

optionA.label: Flat, No Credits
optionA.desc: Top Sintra complaint is credits running out in a day.

optionB.label: Credit Packs
optionB.desc: Matches Lindy and Relevance; buyers already know the model.

pairs.ask: MVP Lane Count: Exactly 3 Lanes (Office, Jobs, Marketing), Or Let Each Pilot Pick?

optionA.label: Fixed Three Lanes
optionA.desc: Same demo every time; easier ops.

optionB.label: Pilot Picks Three
optionB.desc: Fits their business; more setup time per client.

pairs.ask: Daily Rhythm In The Sell: Morning Report By 5 AM Only, Or Morning Plus A Second Daily Touch?

optionA.label: Morning Report Only
optionA.desc: Max retired Evening Report Oct 14; sell what you still run.

optionB.label: Morning Plus Midday Ping
optionB.desc: More touches; higher agent cost and noise.

pairs.ask: Decision UX Moat: Lead With Swipe Decks, Or Lead With Chat Agents?

optionA.label: Lead With Swipe To Decide
optionA.desc: Competitors sell chat, credits or automations; none lead with decks.

optionB.label: Lead With Chat Agents
optionB.desc: Matches Lindy and ChatGPT Business buyer expectations.

pairs.ask: Brand To Sell Under: maxweberman.com, Or A New Brand Name?

optionA.label: maxweberman.com
optionA.desc: Already in every footer; trust with contractors you know.

optionB.label: A New Brand
optionB.desc: Needs domain + USPTO fee about $350 per class.

pairs.ask: Hosting Before Money: Private Login Off Public Pages, Or Stay On Hard-To-Guess Public URLs?

optionA.label: Private Login Required
optionA.desc: Pages terms and privacy; plan sec. 7.

optionB.label: Hard-To-Guess URLs For Pilots
optionB.desc: Faster; client data risk if anything sensitive lands there.

pairs.ask: Votes Storage: Save To A Server, Or Keep Browser localStorage + Share?

optionA.label: Save To A Server
optionA.desc: Owners would lose history on a new phone otherwise.

optionB.label: localStorage + Share For Pilots
optionB.desc: Works today; migrate after first paid month.

pairs.ask: Onboarding: 20-Minute Tally Intake, Or Live Kickoff Call Only?

optionA.label: Tally Intake First
optionA.desc: Free unlimited submissions; answers to Sheets.

optionB.label: Kickoff Call Only
optionB.desc: Higher touch; harder to productize.

pairs.ask: Go To Market: 10 Warm Construction Intros In 2 Weeks, Or Blog And Waitlist First?

optionA.label: Warm Intros First
optionA.desc: Demo on Max's phone; target 3 paid pilots.

optionB.label: Blog And Waitlist First
optionB.desc: Build-in-public posts; slower closed deals.

pairs.ask: Kill Rule: Fewer Than 3 Paid Pilots After 20 Conversations Means Rethink, Or Keep Going?

optionA.label: Keep The Kill Rule
optionA.desc: Forces an honest stop or change.

optionB.label: Extend To 40 Conversations
optionB.desc: More signal; burns more calendar time.

pairs.ask: YouTube Cross-Post: One Build-In-Public Video, Or Keep YouTube Off-Topic?

optionA.label: One Build Video
optionA.desc: Optional; audience is family and Thailand, not contractors.

optionB.label: Stay Off-Topic
optionB.desc: Protect the channel focus.

pairs.ask: Competitor Frame On The Landing Page: Name Lindy And Sintra, Or Stay Feature-Only?

optionA.label: Name Them Honestly
optionA.desc: Investor-deck style honesty; published prices cited Oct 13.

optionB.label: Feature-Only
optionB.desc: Less confrontation; weaker contrast.

pairs.ask: White Label In Team Tier: Client Logo And Colors From Day One, Or Max Brand During Pilots?

optionA.label: Client Brand From Day One
optionA.desc: Differentiation; brand tokens already exist.

optionB.label: Max Brand During Pilots
optionB.desc: Faster setup; white label later.

pairs.ask: Property Managers As Buyers: Park Until Privacy Work Is Done, Or Open A Parallel Waitlist?

optionA.label: Park Until Privacy Work
optionA.desc: Tenant data means more privacy work (plan sec. 6).

optionB.label: Parallel Waitlist Now
optionB.desc: Capture interest; do not onboard yet.

pairs.ask: Analyst Hype Risk: Sell A Visible Daily Outcome, Or Sell Agentic AI As The Hook?

optionA.label: Sell The Daily Outcome
optionA.desc: Gartner (Jun 2025): over 40% of agentic projects canceled by end of 2027.

optionB.label: Sell Agentic AI
optionB.desc: Rides the wave; higher cancel risk for buyers.
